nodes.label: CI Workflow (GitHub Actions macOS)
nodes.rationale: Push/PR macOS gates (swift build/test, run_tests.sh, run_bridge_tests.sh) plus a weekly scheduled bridge-fuzz job, so regressions turn red CI within minutes (core-hardening Phase 3a / OPS-04).

nodes.label: F-02-Class Drift Structural Guard
nodes.rationale: Purpose stated in the CI comment: make F-02-class drift structurally impossible — every verification layer runs on every push/PR instead of being rediscovered by an audit months later.

nodes.label: Audit Remediation Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Fixes ox-alpha audit findings OA-1…OA-5 (delivered 2026-08-25) so the tree is measurement-honest, doc-honest, analytically correct and geometrically resilient before any feature work; zero features by scope; companion to isolyn roadmap.md, legacy handoff.md, fix-log.md, isolyn current audit.md.

nodes.label: OA-1: macOS Soak Test Is a Silent No-Op
nodes.rationale: SoakTest.cpp read RSS only from /proc/self/status (Linux-only); on macOS it printed '[inconclusive]', exited 0 and contributed zero checks, so the 12,000-cycle flat-memory claim was unreproducible on the platform everyone uses.
nodes.norm_label: oa-1: macos soak test is a silent no-op
nodes.community_name: OA-1: macOS Soak Test Is a Silent No-Op

nodes.label: OA-2: Stale 'Never Compiled' Caveats
nodes.rationale: Epistemic 'never compiled / not verified' caveats in Package.swift, EngineTypes/EngineSession, BRIDGE_TESTING, BRIDGE_ARCHITECTURE, legacy handoff and the audit doc are now proven false; annotate, never rewrite history.

nodes.label: OA-3: Resolver Probability Math Overstates Fidelity
nodes.rationale: TileKnowledgeResolver.predictedOpponentProbability divides combined probability across opponents ignoring hand sizes, contradicting its 'mirrors BeliefState' comment; fix = per-opponent-max share plus the resolver's first test suite.
nodes.norm_label: oa-3: resolver probability math overstates fidelity

nodes.label: OA-4: Long Chains Exceed Board/Camera Bounds
nodes.rationale: A near-full-board chain laid rows downward without limit while BoardCamera capped pan at ±300/±200; the last unclosed clause of the UI mandate §17 (scale intelligently, prevent overflow, never crush dominoes).
nodes.norm_label: oa-4: long chains exceed board/camera bounds
nodes.community_name: OA-4: Long Chains Exceed Board/Camera Bounds

nodes.label: OA-5: Open Decisions (Ambiguity #6/#8, Approximation, Weights)
nodes.rationale: All-doubles closer, One Domino Rule mechanics, probabilityHoldsAtLeast independence-approximation acceptance, evaluation-weights sequencing — owner rulings captured in docs/OPEN_DECISIONS.md, never guessed (never-invent rule).

nodes.label: GameSnapshot Test Seam (internal init)
nodes.rationale: Phase 2d widens GameSnapshot.init?(dto:) from fileprivate to internal so headless BoardLayoutTests and resolver tests can fabricate snapshots; anchor comment keeps it from being 'tidied' back.

nodes.label: Core Hardening Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Makes the core architecture sound and extremely strong before the planned UI revival; zero features/redesign; findings F-04…F-12 plus new N-series; companion to isolyn roadmap.md, isolyn current audit.md, fix-log.md, legacy handoff.md.

nodes.label: Bridge Architecture (Design Doc)
nodes.rationale: What the Swift/C++ bridge is and deliberately is not; companion to BRIDGE_TESTING.md and IsolynBridge.hpp — 'this document explains it, the header IS it'.

nodes.label: Swift/C++ Bridge (POD-Only Safety Wall)
nodes.rationale: Narrow layer between the SwiftUI app and the authoritative C++ engine; adds a boundary safe against untrusted/malformed input, the one concurrency policy the engine has no opinion about, and a stable POD-only surface (uint64 handles, no STL crossing).

nodes.label: Two-Phase Analysis Design
nodes.rationale: chooseBestMove (depth 4 × 20 determinizations) is slow: phase 1 takes the mutex, clones GameState and builds BeliefState, then releases; phase 2 runs detached on that independent copy so nothing else on the session blocks.

nodes.label: Match Orchestration Surface (bridge_match_*)
nodes.rationale: bridge_match_begin/record_round/close wrap a running ScoreSystem; finalHandValues reveal-on-end only (zeroed mid-round, no hidden-info leak); scoring math stays in the engine, policy lives Swift-side in MatchCoordinator.

nodes.label: Bridge Testing (Verification Record)
nodes.rationale: Every number from a real command in this exact repo state; Linux Ubuntu sandbox, no Swift toolchain ever; engine 356/356, bridge 33/33, ASan/UBSan/TSan zero findings, fuzz crash found and fixed, soak flat.

nodes.label: Adversarial-Input Fuzz Campaign (FuzzBridge.cpp)
nodes.rationale: A 5-second run found a real crash within ~18,000 executions; after the fix a 120-second run completed 75,451 executions with zero crashes, zero sanitizer findings and an 838-input corpus.

nodes.label: Blocked-Current-Player Analysis UB (Fuzz-Found)
nodes.rationale: bridge_analysis_snapshot_create never verified currentPlayerHasLegalMove before handing a snapshot to chooseBestMove, which documents that precondition and doesn't check it itself — silent undefined behavior under Release/NDEBUG.

nodes.label: No Swift Toolchain Available (Linux Sandbox)
nodes.rationale: Swift consumer code was hand-reviewed against bridge signatures, never compiler-checked in early sessions — the epistemic caveat OA-2's doc-truth sweep later retired.

nodes.label: Feature Specifications (Training & Sandbox)
nodes.rationale: Real product intent captured ahead of the UI layer; UX/feature specification kept deliberately separate from strategy knowledge; both modes are explanation-consumers that need PositionConstructor beyond Dealer's random deals.

nodes.label: PositionConstructor (Not Yet Built)
nodes.rationale: Shared answer to both modes' position construction (plausible mid-game state for Training; user-specified positions for Sandbox) — worth prioritizing once UI work starts.

nodes.label: ExplanationEngine (Not Yet Built)
nodes.rationale: 'Very simple but deep… contextual reasoning' — accessible plain language carrying real domain insight; design should be driven by these two concrete use cases, not in the abstract.

nodes.label: Release Checklist
nodes.rationale: Core-hardening Phase 3c: complete pre-researched checklist (Xcode app shell, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy + CoreLocation, NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription, WeatherKit capability, hardened runtime, signing/notarization) so packaging is execution, not archaeology; every box unchecked.

nodes.label: Strategy Notes (Domain Knowledge for Engine Contributors)
nodes.rationale: Captured domain knowledge for EvaluationEngine/ProbabilityEngine/DifficultyModel to encode later; explicitly not MoveValidator/MoveGenerator concerns, which only decide legality.
nodes.norm_label: strategy notes (domain knowledge for engine contributors)
nodes.community_name: Strategy Notes (Domain Knowledge for Engine Contributors)

nodes.label: Closing vs Domino-Run Decision (Estimation-Driven)
nodes.rationale: Forcing a Close freezes the opponent's hand value and guarantees next-round start; whether to close is a genuine expected-value comparison fed by belief-state estimates, never a fixed rule.

nodes.label: 1v1 Look-Ahead Depth (5–7 Moves)
nodes.rationale: Strong players infer 5–7 moves ahead; kept as an approximate calibration target for SearchEngine/DifficultyModel, not a hard number.

nodes.label: Elite Lockdown-Double Tactic (Confidence Reads)
nodes.rationale: Inferred-specific-double lockdown with aggressive draining; strong players reason in explicit confidence percentages (50/50, 70/30) — human validation that BeliefState should expose real confidence levels.

nodes.label: Dominoes UI Fix — Non-Negotiable Mandate
nodes.rationale: Rejects the prior presentation layer outright and specifies structure/geometry/hierarchy as law; executed in its own §29 order and closed by owner visual sign-off ('looks amazing') per fix-log UI-QA — fully satisfied, not partially.

nodes.label: Single-Rectangle Domino Law (§2)
nodes.rationale: The document's most important requirement: a domino is ONE continuous rectangle — internal 1px divider, zero physical gap, exact 2:1 ratio intact at every scale; conflicting implementations must be deleted or rewritten.

nodes.label: Fix Log (12-Field Protocol Entries)
nodes.rationale: Executed and verified fixes from the 2026-08 sessions (commits b79a3f4 → 0d63200 and on), each citing grep-able anchors; format follows aggressive-bug-fix-protocol.md; verification via legacy handoff.md 'Check My Work'.

nodes.label: FIX-07: Terminal-Round Guard (RoundAlreadyOver = 10)
nodes.rationale: Mutators checked stale-version but never round-state, so play could continue past a finished round; additive ABI-safe enum value 10, checked after the stale gate; suite 33→40 checks.

nodes.label: FIX-09: Match Orchestration Surface + Logged Invariants
nodes.rationale: Reveal-on-end only, duplicate record rejection, SESSION→MATCH lock ordering, next starter derived via RulesEngine — suite 40→57; audit-relevant part is the invariants.
nodes.norm_label: fix-09: match orchestration surface + logged invariants
nodes.community_name: FIX-09: Match Orchestration Surface + Logged Invariants

nodes.label: Session: UI Rebuild (UI-01…UI-QA)
nodes.rationale: Mandate executed §29 steps 1→8: canonical single-rectangle renderer, snake-chain board, real hand + screen chrome; owner reviewed the running app and confirmed the rebuild.

nodes.label: FIX-27: Darwin RSS Soak Truth + ASan Quarantine De-confound (OA-1)
nodes.rationale: Mach task introspection RSS branch plus loud WARNING banner; run_sanitize.sh pins quarantine_size_mb=16 so the post-warmup growth check measures the program, not the ~256MB ASan quarantine; soak now contributes a real 59th bridge check.

nodes.community_name: FIX-27: Darwin RSS Soak Truth + ASan Quarantine De-confound (OA-1)

nodes.label: FIX-28: SnakeChainLayout + Latent Snake-Bug Fix (OA-4)
nodes.rationale: Placement/extent/fit math hoisted into pure SnakeChainLayout; uniform auto-fit scale preserves 2:1 by construction; camera bounds grow with residual overflow; internal GameSnapshot test seam; en route found and fixed a pre-existing unsigned-advance bug that sent any chain >1 row off-board.

nodes.label: Isolyn Current Audit (Markdown edition)
nodes.rationale: Ox-alpha line-by-line audit of all 114 files with live verification on Apple Silicon — a first for this codebase; findings F-01…F-12, knowledge-graph trace findings F-T1…F-T5 (Appendix C), core-hardening resolution ledger (Appendix D).

nodes.label: F-02: run_tests.sh Link Failure on macOS
nodes.rationale: Verification scripts omitted -framework Security for EntropySource's SecRandomCopyBytes, so the headline 356/356 claim was unreproducible on the shipping platform.
nodes.norm_label: f-02: run_tests.sh link failure on macos
nodes.community_name: F-02: run_tests.sh Link Failure on macOS

nodes.label: F-03: No Terminal-State Guard in Bridge Mutators
nodes.rationale: Fresh-version commands kept mutating a finished round (DominoVictory leaves opponents legal moves); racing/buggy UI could corrupt round semantics for future consumers.
nodes.norm_label: f-03: no terminal-state guard in bridge mutators
nodes.community_name: F-03: No Terminal-State Guard in Bridge Mutators

nodes.label: F-05: No App Packaging Substrate
nodes.rationale: SPM executable only — no privacy manifest, no location usage strings despite CLLocationManager access, WeatherKit capability documented-but-absent, no icon pipeline; not distributable as-is.

nodes.label: F-11: applyOpponentDraw Divide-by-Zero (NDEBUG)
nodes.rationale: Debug-only assert guarded boneyard-mass precondition; under NDEBUG division by zero mass yields NaN beliefs — latent public-API hazard.

nodes.label: Appendix C: Graph Trace Findings (F-T1…F-T5)
nodes.rationale: F-T2: SearchEngine.cpp is the graph's articulation point — architecture rationale, the historical fuzz bug, the cancellation contract and both unbuilt features route through it, so its contract changes carry blast radius into shipped and planned code alike.

nodes.label: Isolyn Implementation Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Seven phases sized as % of remaining effort to Isolyn 1.0 — correctness lock + match orchestration, game board, DifficultyModel/AI, PositionConstructor/Sandbox, ExplanationEngine/Training, polish, release engineering; hardest problems first; governs all feature work after the remediation and hardening roadmaps.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Correctness Lock & Match Architecture
nodes.rationale: Terminal-round guard with a NEW status (RoundAlreadyOver = 10, not reused InvalidRequest), additive ABI safety, fail-closed check ordering on all four mutators, plus the MatchCoordinator/bridge match-recording design with explicit edge cases.

nodes.label: MatchCoordinator Design (Math in Engine, Policy in Swift)
nodes.rationale: Scoring math stays in tested C++ single-source-of-truth code; session lifecycle policy lives in a thin @MainActor @Observable Swift coordinator — the bridge grows data plumbing, not rules.
nodes.norm_label: matchcoordinator design (math in engine, policy in swift)
nodes.community_name: MatchCoordinator Design (Math in Engine, Policy in Swift)

nodes.label: Phase 3: DifficultyModel + AI Turns + Calibration
nodes.rationale: Strength dial 100–3000 mapped to depth×determinizations tiers; calibration harness (tools/selfplay.cpp) emits win-rate ladders (each tier ≥55% over previous) and declining win-rate-vs-hand-quality correlation; heuristic-weight tuning explicitly deferred to avoid confounding the ladder signals.

nodes.label: Legacy Handoff (Read Me First)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for status AND rules, written for 'a human who has never coded, OR an AI that is small, weak, and has no memory' — contains the scoreboard, folder map, twelve ambiguity resolutions, house rules and ten copy-paste proofs; original HANDOFF.md retired into §5.

nodes.label: House Rules 1–8
nodes.rationale: Never claim without running; never invent probabilities/rules; no placeholders; commit every meaningful chunk; owner gates on DifficultyModel; engine computes all game truth; zero build residue via clean.sh; fix-log/tree.md/graphify must match exact project state — a stale map is a false map.

nodes.label: Twelve Ambiguity Resolutions (Numbering Load-Bearing)
nodes.rationale: Code comments cite these resolutions by number; #8 (One Domino Rule mechanics) is explicitly NOT implemented pending an owner conversation; #12 pins the every-BeliefState-sums-to-28 test-writing law.
